qualification.details: Registrar & Controller of Examinations: Master's degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade. At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in Academic Level 11 and above or with 8 years of service in Academic Level 12 and above, including as Associate Professor, with experience in educational administration or comparable experience in research establishments or institutions of higher education, or 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. Senior System Analyst: B.E./B.Tech. (Computer Science & Engineering) with at least 55% of marks and 9 years of experience in programming and System Management from a recognized organization OR M.Sc. (Computer Science)/MCA/M.Tech. (Computer Science & Engineering) with 55% of marks and 8 years' experience in programming and system management from a recognized organization.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Tripura University Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Tripura University to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications for the Tripura University Recruitment 2026 is 11th September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before this date to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Registrar in the Tripura University Recruitment 2026. The total number of vacancies released by the university is three across various posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification for the Registrar post is a Master's degree with at least 55% marks. Additionally, candidates must possess at least 15 years of relevant experience as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this recruitment is 57 years. Age relaxation will be provided to candidates belonging to reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for candidates belonging to the General and OBC categories is Rs. 1000/-. Please refer to the official notification for details on fees for other categories, if any.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior System Analyst post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Senior System Analyst post is as per Level-12 of the pay matrix. Specific details regarding the pay scale can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Tripura University Recruitment 2026 will be conducted as per the Cadre Recruitment Rules – 2023 of Tripura University. Further details will be communicated to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Tripura apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Therefore, candidates from all over India who meet the eligibility criteria are likely eligible to apply for these positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article by clicking on the provided link. It is highly recommended to read the PDF thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Tripura University?
faq.answer: The official website of Tripura University is www.tripurauniv.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information about the university and its recruitments.
